text: Trust & transparency update: rewritten About page, new Methodology page, this changelog, per-page source and verification panels, "Report an error" links on every page, site-wide search, breadcrumbs, Atom feed and a new footer.
New Cybersecurity section: a vulnerability watch for exploited CVEs and hardening recipes for network, endpoints, servers, services and VMware.
New pillar guide: how to roll out Microsoft Copilot without opening a hole in your tenant (9 phases, printable checklist).
Full fact-check pass of every recipe against current Microsoft Learn pages; 18 recipes corrected.
New homepage, logo and Identity & threat protection track.
Tenant Recipes launched on GitHub Pages.
